text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oho, awesome! Rhein Kraft really knows how 
to run...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's the girl who's been saying "I'm 
going for the Triple Tiara!" since before 
her debut, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
With this level of ability in the Junior 
Class, we can expect huge things in the 
Classic Class...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!! Keep giving it your all, 
Craft~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!! Ehehe, thank you so muuuuch!!
choice_data_list: Craft! You did a fantastic job—!
Craft! You did a fantastic job—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heeere I aaaaam!! I gave it my allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Alright. ...Yes, yes, YES!! The crowd is 
cheering for me! And Trainer is, too...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I—I had a great run, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ha... hah... phew...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Traaaiiineeer~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm back! Made it home safe and 
sound.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Thank you for cheering so loudly 
for me earlier.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I felt that "I did it!" 
feeling so many times!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And—um! Why don't we decide on our next 
goal right now!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've already thought it through! If we're 
aiming for our next goal, then—
choice_data_list: It's the Fillies' Revue, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah!? I-I wanted to say that~!

While soothing her slightly pouting 
expression, I thought to myself, "Just as 
I expected."

After all, the Fillies' Revue is the trial 
race leading up to the ultimate goal, the 
Oka Sho.

Many Umamusume aiming for the Oka Sho, the 
first crown of the Triple Tiara, will 
surely enter this race. There's no better 
chance to test our mettle.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
After all, Ramonu, who achieved the first 
Triple Tiara in history, won the Fillies' 
Revue too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Following in our great senior's 
footsteps to victory! With elegance! To 
keep... the momentum... going!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I-I'd love your help training for that, 
too, but... eeeek~...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haah...! C-Could I please have a short 
break... loff!?
choice_data_list: You're right. Let's take a quick breather.
Yeah. Let's take a breather for now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hai-eeee~...! Haaah, my body feels so 
heavy... I bet I'm going to have terrible 
muscle aches tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"GⅠ races really are incredibly 
exhausting, aren't they...?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...! O-ow, ow, ow, ow...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Still have muscle soreness~! But I guess 
it's gotten a whole lot better?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me to rest until today, 
but... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm here~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, even if it's just a light run! 
Because once the Fillies' Revue is over, 
the Oka Sho will be right around the 
corner—)
(Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ? What's that, a crowd—?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa!! Haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Huh... Wait, what!? Is that Heart-san!? 
She's completely battered...?!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Pushing herself that hard in training...? 
Even though the Hanshin JF just ended!)

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? If it isn't Craft. Resuming 
training today?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Ah, um... H-Hello. ...Um, are you 
Heart-san—

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"...Heart, huh... I wonder. We first 
spotted her during afternoon training the 
day after the Hanshin JF, though."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Still, knowing Heart... she might have 
been out running laps early that morning 
or something.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
She told me after the Hanshin JF... ...'I 
can't go on like this.'

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Standing tall and proud as always, with a 
bright smile. ...Yet, completely 
decisive."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! N-Not good, you say...? Really?! 
Heart ran super well in the Hanshin JF, 
didn't she?!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, totally, totally!! I was so hyped 
up, you know?! My heart was going crazy! 
Like, 'She's so strong! Super cuuuute and 
cool!!'

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, thanks! I'm honored you feel that 
way♪"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"No, seriously, I'm not just flattering 
you! ...Wait, remember, it was written in 
that article too, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! They called her "an 
Umamusume who's guaranteed to run in next 
year's Triple Tiara Oka Sho"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's right! However—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to the Oka Sho just to 
participate. —I'm going there to win.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, Line Craft's performance in 
the Hanshin JF was beyond my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Far more than I ever imagined... ...She 
had evolved.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And—obviously, by the time the Oka Sho 
arrives, she will definitely have evolved 
even further."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft has that kind of caliber.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text: A, a heart... but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
? Ahaha, stop that! Why the long face? 
This is just 『the current reality』, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's all it is... for now. ――Really, 
that's just all there is to it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's only true <color=italic>for now</color>. Then all I have 
to do is change what comes next."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just polish. Just get stronger. Just break 
through.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because I'm—the future queen.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... it takes courage, right? 
To face your own weaknesses, your 
shortcomings, and all that.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yet Heart is facing it head-on. 
...Carrying the courage passed down by her 
mother in her heart, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san... So that's why you were so—

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"...W-Well, that's just how it is! Though 
I guess it sounds kinda weird coming from 
us."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
This match isn't over yet, Craft. ...The 
one who's gonna win is definitely our 
queen, Daring Heart!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!! Pheeew...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(...Get it together, me! Just because I 
had a decent run in a GⅠ race doesn't mean 
I can slack off!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(She totally called me out on slacking 
off... What Heart-san said earlier was 
incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(So much. ...What was that? It gave me 
goosebumps...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Am I taking this just as seriously? Am I 
truly facing the race head-on? ...No!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "I have to face it! From now on...!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaah--!!

And Rhein Kraft dashes forward. Toward her 
next goal, the Fillies' Revue...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! I saw someone running really well 
and wondered who it was... Turns out it's 
Line Kraft~!"

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, she's amazing, isn't she! 
Isn't she at least the top favorite for 
the Oka Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's probably too early to make a 
call like that. ...Though there's no doubt 
they're a very promising prospect.
